sys_script_include.description: Staged module orchestration for submissions: creates module cases per the resolved module plan, activates run groups, advances on module completion, and handles updates (override in place or cut a new submission version). Every plan decision is delegated to ModulePlanService - this service holds no module-to-table map and does not parse the licence property. Called by the Orchestration: flows.
sys_script_include.name: OrchestrationService
